evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows', modifies CMake build configuration, presets, and Windows CI scripts to transition native Windows compilation from cl.exe to clang-cl.
rationale: Migrating native Windows builds to clang-cl resolves ongoing compiler bugs and ICEs (#31456) while cutting CI compilation times from 20m 35s to 12m 43s. It also significantly improves block connection throughput on Windows (from 7.40 to 11.52 blocks/s for ECDSA) and unblocks architecture-specific inline assembly optimizations.
